instruction.name: x86mftop
instruction.description: Read the x87 TOP pointer into rd.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: x86mftop $r12; x86mftop $r13; x86mftop $r14; x86mftop $r15; x86mftop $r16; x86mftop $r17; x86mftop $r18; x86mftop $r19
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'x86mttop 0' --asm 'x86mftop $r12; x86mftop $r13; x86mftop $r14; x86mftop $r15; x86mftop $r16; x86mftop $r17; x86mftop $r18; x86mftop $r19'

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. Throughput only.
